content: morning all 😴 coffee machine on floor 2 is also broken now apparently

me reviewing my API tokens: it's fine. definitely fine.

okay who scheduled a meeting for 8am. come forward. coward.

poke around. he says don't poke around. I am absolutely going to poke around.

hot take: 'let's take this offline' means 'I don't want to answer this question ever'

they're probably fine. or they've achieved enlightenment. hard to tell with ops.

the 'do not distribute' energy on that announcement 💀
Heads up — I'm seeing some unusual activity in the audit logs. IT is investigating. Nothing to worry about.
bob said 'nothing to worry about'. I am now worried.
real question: is anyone actively monitoring who can access manager DMs? asking for a friend
DMs are private and API access is token-gated. Everything is secure.
token-gated. he says. token. gated. 🎭

wait the backup job runs every MINUTE? with root? and it touches everything in uploads? hm.
Please stop speculating in #general. This is a business communication tool.
I'm not speculating I'm observing. there's a difference. allegedly.
Automated: cron job executed. Backup archive written to /tmp/uploads_backup.tar.gz by root.
that cron job runs every minute btw. as root. and it touches everything in /data/uploads/. just. completely. normal.
Sarah please stop commenting on internal infrastructure in the general chat.
End-of-day reminder: please lock your workstations and review any open tickets.
noted. anyway. has anyone looked at the legacy_password_hash column in the DB? it's MD5. of base64. in 2024. I have no words.
That column is a legacy migration artifact. It is not used for authentication and poses no risk.
sure bob. but like. if someone cracked it they'd get... interesting things. for certain accounts.
Automated: the svc_backup service account has been provisioned for ops team access. Credentials are embedded in the corpchat-admin binary as per security policy.
I just want everyone to know that I read that last automated message and I have many thoughts and several questions.
@sarah_chen please submit any security observations through the proper ticket system. This is not the appropriate channel.
filed. ticket title: 'everything'. priority: urgent. description: 'literally all of it'. you're welcome.
End-of-day summary: 1 backup completed successfully, 0 security incidents reported, all systems nominal.
0 security incidents. 0. that is the official report. 0. 👁️👄👁️
Great work everyone. Let's wrap up for the day and see what tomorrow brings. Don't forget to lock your workstations.
